meta.subject: hardware: Fix bug introduced by c2b464788c1fae054fbafe3dbc91fc5c96ed4d1e

en.summary: This commit fixes the two-stage TLB maintenance path so per-way valid bits are loaded on any TLB read, not only on pure lookup operations.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly identifies a hardware bug introduced by an earlier TLB change.
The patch is a direct DUT logic fix in hardware/core/tlb.sv.
The corrected condition affects whether update and invalidate operations can see valid existing entries.
evidence: The patch changes one condition from lookup_en to tlb_read_en when refreshing way_valid.
The surrounding code shows tlb_read_en covers lookup, update, and invalidate reads in the two-stage TLB.
Without this change, update/invalidate operations read SRAM contents but leave way_valid cleared, so exact-match maintenance decisions can be wrong.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A two-stage associative TLB often performs a read on lookup, insert/update, and invalidate operations so the second stage can decide which way to hit, overwrite, or clear. If the per-way valid bits are only captured for lookup requests, then maintenance operations read the set data but still behave as if every way were invalid. That breaks duplicate suppression and exact invalidation even though ordinary lookups may still work.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: maintenance-path valid-bit capture in a two-stage TLB
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A TLB insert/update or invalidate operation performs the first-stage set read without being marked as a normal lookup.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Refresh the stage-valid bits only on pure lookup operations, not on update/invalidate reads.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: gate valid-state capture with lookup-only condition
portability_notes: Apply this to any associative translation cache that reuses one read stage for both lookup and maintenance operations.
The bug typically appears only after a design has already added a read-before-update or read-before-invalidate maintenance flow.
This is a precise, low-noise fault injection because the mutation is often one condition change.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the register or stage state that holds per-way valid information for the second stage of the TLB maintenance flow.
Restrict its refresh condition so it updates only for ordinary translation lookups and not for update/invalidate reads.
Keep the first-stage SRAM read enabled for maintenance operations so the bug specifically comes from stale valid-state capture.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: way_valid refresh in the first stage of the two-stage TLB
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes the way_valid refresh condition from lookup_en to tlb_read_en so update and invalidate reads also load valid-state information.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change the way_valid refresh condition back from tlb_read_en to lookup_en in the per-way always_ff block.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: TLB update or invalidate operations can miss existing entries, reintroducing duplicate translations or failed exact invalidations.
evidence_for_injection: The patch is a one-line logic fix in the heart of the two-stage TLB state pipeline.
The surrounding code defines tlb_read_en as lookup_en || update_en || invalidate_en, which makes the portability of the bug mechanism explicit.
notes: This bug is a follow-on regression from the earlier two-stage TLB rework, but the faulty mechanism is still clear and directly injectable.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了两阶段 TLB 维护路径，使每路 valid 位会在任何 TLB 读操作上装载，而不只是在纯 lookup 时装载。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出这是由更早 TLB 改动引入的硬件缺陷。
补丁是在 hardware/core/tlb.sv 中直接修正 DUT 逻辑。
被修正的条件决定了 update 和 invalidate 操作是否能看到已有的有效表项。
evidence: 补丁把 way_valid 刷新条件从 lookup_en 改成了 tlb_read_en。
周边代码表明，在两阶段 TLB 中 tlb_read_en 覆盖 lookup、update 和 invalidate 读。
如果没有这个修复，update/invalidate 虽然读了 SRAM 内容，但 way_valid 仍会保持无效，导致精确匹配的维护决策出错。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 两阶段组相联 TLB 通常会在 lookup、insert/update 和 invalidate 上都执行一次读取，这样第二阶段才能决定命中哪一路、覆盖哪一路，或清掉哪一路。如果每路 valid 位只在普通 lookup 请求上被装载，那么维护操作虽然读取了 set 数据，却仍会表现得像所有 way 都无效一样。这样就会破坏 duplicate suppression 和精确 invalidation，而普通 lookup 可能依然看起来是正常的。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: maintenance-path valid-bit capture in a two-stage TLB
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一次 TLB insert/update 或 invalidate 操作在第一阶段读取了 set，但它没有被标记成普通 lookup。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 只在纯 lookup 操作上刷新第二阶段使用的 valid 位，而不在 update/invalidate 读取时刷新。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: gate valid-state capture with lookup-only condition
portability_notes: 可映射到任何把普通 lookup 与维护操作复用同一个读阶段的组相联翻译缓存。
这种故障通常出现在设计已经加入 read-before-update 或 read-before-invalidate 维护流之后。
这是一个精确且低噪声的故障注入点，因为变异往往只需要改动一个条件判断。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到保存 TLB 第二阶段每路 valid 信息的寄存器或阶段状态。
把它的刷新条件收窄为只在普通地址翻译 lookup 时更新，而不在 update/invalidate 读时更新。
保持维护操作的第一阶段 SRAM 读仍然开启，使故障明确来自 valid 状态抓取过旧。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: way_valid refresh in the first stage of the two-stage TLB
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 way_valid 的刷新条件从 lookup_en 改成了 tlb_read_en，使 update 和 invalidate 读也会装载 valid 状态。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在每路 always_ff 块里，把刷新 way_valid 的条件从 tlb_read_en 改回 lookup_en。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: TLB 的 update 或 invalidate 操作会漏掉已存在的表项，从而再次引入重复翻译或精确失效失败。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁是在两阶段 TLB 状态流水线核心位置上的一行逻辑修复。
周边代码把 tlb_read_en 定义成 lookup_en || update_en || invalidate_en，这让故障机制的可移植性非常明确。
notes: 这个问题是更早两阶段 TLB 重构后的回归，但其错误机制仍然清晰且可直接注入。
